features.name: Project Setup & Environment Verification
features.description: Confirm the project can run verification, execute syntax checks, and maintain running development services.
features.evidence: ./init.sh ran successfully: python syntax check passed, pytest test suite ready, Django API running on 8100.

features.name: AI Audio Drama & Video Generation Engine
features.description: LangGraph multi-step dramatization workflow, character voice casting with TTS, and scene-by-scene script breakdown.
features.evidence: backend/ai_studio/services/audio_drama_graph.py and tts_service.py implemented with MinIO storage and Inngest workflows.

features.name: Remotion Video & Timeline Rendering Bridge
features.description: Bridge Django scene sequences and timing into Remotion JSON timeline format for automated video compilation.

features.name: Documentary Web & Visual Search Integration
features.description: Enable autonomous web image search and media ingestion for documentary and manga style scenes.
features.evidence: Web search tools connected, visual prompt generators wired in Gemini Flash pipelines.

features.name: DesignCombo Web Studio Removal & UI Streamlining
features.description: Completely deprecate and purge DesignCombo React SPA (frontend/), port 5173, and UI deep links, consolidating interface in monolithic Django studio.
features.evidence: frontend/ directory purged, port 5173 CORS origins removed, UI header button, studio cards, and action chips removed from chat interface.

features.name: Hybrid Multi-User Authentication & Data Isolation
features.description: Hybrid JWT + Django Session authentication with full per-user data isolation on BookProject, ChatMessage, and ChatThread models.
features.evidence: Custom HS256 JWT auth implemented in backend/ai_studio/auth.py, all API endpoints protected by JWTAuth and django_auth, migration 0007 applied, passing 46 auth tests.

features.name: ChatGPT-Style Conversation Memory & Thread Persistence
features.description: ChatThread model with PostgreSQL persistence, sliding window memory context (last 20 messages), rolling smart summary, AI thread titling, and soft-delete.
features.evidence: ChatThread model created in migrations 0008 & 0009, thread CRUD endpoints /api/threads wired into /api/chat and /api/upload-book, passing 7 dedicated thread tests and 33 E2E tests.

features.name: Studio UI Sidebar, Auth Modals, Visitor Onboarding & Profile Media
features.description: Collapsible sidebar with recency grouped threads (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Older), inline rename and soft-delete, login/register modals, pending prompt visitor onboarding, and profile media library endpoint.
features.evidence: RTL obsidian theme updated in backend/templates/chat/index.html with login/register modals, authFetch wrapper, dynamic sidebar thread rendering, and /api/profile/media endpoint.

features.name: Profile & Projects Hub Modal with Media Library & Multi-User Isolation
features.description: Interactive modern obsidian modal (#profileModal) with tabs for Projects, Audio Clips, Video Scenes, Scripts, and Account Stats, featuring inline project renaming, project deletion, direct audio streaming, and dual access triggers in header and sidebar.
features.evidence: Implemented #profileModal and #projectRenameModal in index.html, added PATCH /api/projects/{id}/rename and DELETE /api/projects/{id} endpoints in api.py, enhanced GET /api/profile/media with stats, passing 7 dedicated tests in tests_profile.py.

features.name: Modular Django Apps Architecture & Tools Menu Cleanup
features.description: Refactor backend into 4 decoupled Django apps (core, book_drama, story_writer, image_video) with db_table preservation and zero data loss; clean up tools menu by removing voice trigger and renaming video tool to 'إنتاج فيلم وفيديو بالصور'.
features.evidence: 4 Django apps created and registered in INSTALLED_APPS, models facade preserved, tools popup menu refined to 3 tools in index.html, passing 158 tests via ./init.sh.

features.name: Standalone TTS Studio App with Large-Text Chunking & Concatenation
features.description: Standalone Django app 'tts' with sentence-boundary chunking (<2500 chars), Gemini Flash TTS synthesis, wave PCM stitching, Arabic auto-diacritization toggle, full official 30 Gemini voices catalog, 135+ languages, 19 Arabic dialects, 32 emotions, 25 delivery styles, and Obsidian/limeAccent modal without cartoon emojis.
features.evidence: backend/tts/ options catalog expanded with 30 official Gemini voices, 135+ world languages, 19 Arabic dialects, 32 emotions, and 25 delivery styles; freq_map acoustic generator supports all 30 voices and dynamic custom voices with emotion cadence/pitch modulation; #ttsConfigModal overhauled to Obsidian/limeAccent dark theme with voice search/gender filtering and zero emojis; renderTTSAudioCard updated with clean typography monogram and text transcript preview; auto_diacritize toggle wired; 18/18 tests passing in tests_tts.py and 176/176 in ./init.sh.

features.name: Guest Privacy Shield & Dedicated UUID Thread Navigation
features.description: Protect guest privacy by suppressing all prior projects and chat records in logged-out mode with a sleek login CTA; ensure '+ محادثة جديدة' generates a persistent ChatThread UUID via POST /api/threads, dynamically updates the browser URL (?thread_id=<UUID>), cleanly clears the chat feed, and isolates all subsequent messages.
features.evidence: backend/ai_studio/views.py filters projects to request.user only (empty for guests); index.html renders login CTA without history leaks; startNewChat generates new UUID thread via POST /api/threads, updates URL to ?thread_id=<uuid>, wipes #dynamicChatFeed; chat_endpoint automatically titles threads upon first message; passing 9/9 in tests_threads.py and 178/178 in ./init.sh.

features.name: Desktop Collapsible Sidebar, Guest Full-Width Canvas & Fast New-Chat Flow
features.description: Smooth toggleable sidebar for desktop and mobile with persistent state in localStorage; completely hide sidebar and toggle controls for logged-out visitors for 100% full-width chat canvas without history leaks; provide header '+ محادثة جديدة' action and robust state-resetting startNewChat flow.
features.evidence: backend/templates/chat/index.html updated with desktop sidebar-collapsed CSS transition, unified #sidebarToggleBtn (Ctrl+B), #headerNewChatBtn (Ctrl+K), visitor mode complete DOM purge and hide, and isolated startNewChat thread generation; 11/11 tests passing in backend/ai_studio/tests_threads.py.
